propositions: Plan-review end-to-end command wall time is approximately 15–22 minutes (current regime p50 × 1.20 through p90 × 1.20) with known p99 tail to 94 minutes; inner workflow metrics.total_ms understates operator wait by omitting setup, overlap-judge, and post-sidecar work.

Gated ticket close (transition to in_progress/closed) wall time is approximately 35–70 minutes (current regime) driven by pre-verifier commit_impact.referencing_commits directory scanning and known p99 tail to 62 minutes; inner verifier metrics.total_ms significantly understates end-to-end delay.

Provider-provenance attribution (Bedrock fix 2026-08-07 commit c390cef) and explicit llm_calls > 0 filtering remove deterministic/preflight short-circuits and misrouted runs; these cleanings do not alter the primary inner-sidecar statistics but exclude about 160 zero-model plan-review rows.

End-to-end Codex JSONL session matching (620 rollout files, 78 plan and 38 close observations with model sidecars, full window 2026-08-11 through 2026-08-23) reveals nonstationary performance; current regime (2026-08-22 onward) shows p50 12.6–28.2 min and p90 17.6–57.3 min, more representative of operator experience than full-window median.

Discovered bug grassy-cracked-morpho (commit_impact.referencing_commits scan on every impact-present close, ~3.8 million ticket-directory visits before verifier) explains dominant pre-verifier tail; relates to closed bug reportable-chalkstony-eeve.
